what: Link Survey Clusters to Raster Exposures and Fit Bayesian Spatial Models
title: Link Survey Clusters to Raster Exposures and Fit Bayesian Spatial Models
text: svyexpo links geocoded household surveys (DHS, MICS, ) raster exposures fits Bayesian spatial models exposure–outcome associations, including effects vary across space. Existing packages SUMMER surveyPrev focus small-area prevalence mapping. svyexpo focuses associations: much environmental exposure (PM₂.₅, greenness, temperature) changes outcome, effect stronger weaker.

title: Link Survey Clusters to Raster Exposures and Fit Bayesian Spatial Models
text: Requires R >= 4.1. Modules 1-4 (ingest, boundaries, exposure linkage, adjacency) work without INLA; model fitting posterior summaries need INLA, spatially varying coefficients also need sn.
code: # install.packages("remotes") remotes::install_github("niiattey/svyexpo")  # INLA is needed for model fitting and is not on CRAN: install.packages("INLA",   repos = c(getOption("repos"), INLA = "https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/stable"),   dep = TRUE)  # Needed for spatially varying coefficients (posterior sampling): install.packages("sn")

title: Link Survey Clusters to Raster Exposures and Fit Bayesian Spatial Models
text: Every push tested GitHub Actions: Intel Macs tested. Model tests Linux macOS run directly INLA required; Windows run inside R CMD check. Known issue. Inside R CMD check Linux macOS, INLA’s program fails models spatial graph (error: “N simultaneous processes spawned”), models run normally outside R CMD check Windows. package’s checks therefore skip model fitting INLA fit small test model, separate CI job runs model tests outside R CMD check. cause yet identified. appeared run outside R CMD check.

title: Link Survey Clusters to Raster Exposures and Fit Bayesian Spatial Models
text: Run vignette("svyexpo") full example simulated data.
code: library(svyexpo)  pts   <- svy_from_dhs(kr, gps, id_vars = c("v001", "v002", "v003", "bidx")) areas <- svy_boundaries("GHA", level = 2) pts   <- svy_assign_areas(pts, areas)  expo  <- svy_extract_by_year(svy_buffers(pts), "pm25_2000_2022.tif", name = "pm25") dat   <- merge(sf::st_drop_geometry(pts), expo, by = "id")  graph <- svy_adjacency(areas) fit   <- svy_fit_bym2(dat, stunted ~ pm25 + urban, graph, svc = "pm25") svy_map(svy_svc_effects(fit, "pm25", exponentiate = TRUE), areas)

text: boundaries sf polygon object. area_col Area identifier column. Must unique. queen Use queen contiguity (shared vertex) rather rook (shared edge). connect_islands Link island nearest area. snap Distance tolerance passed spdep::poly2nb(), units boundary CRS. Small values fix slivers neighbouring polygons quite touch.

title: Build the spatial neighbourhood graph for areal models — svy_adjacency
text: object class svy_graph: list adj: sparse binary adjacency matrix (Matrix::dgCMatrix) nb: spdep neighbour list index: data frame mapping area_col integer area_idx n_components: number connected components islands_linked: area ids connected neighbour

title: Build the spatial neighbourhood graph for areal models — svy_adjacency
text: area index matters: INLA identifies areas integer position graph, data must indexed ordering. svy_fit_bym2() handles using index table returned . Disconnected groups several areas (example archipelago region) left separate components. BYM2 scale.model = TRUE scales component separately, recommended treatment (Freni-Sterrantino et al., 2018, Spatial Spatio-temporal Epidemiology 26:25-34).

what: Fit a BYM2 model with optional spatially varying coefficients — svy_fit_bym2
title: Fit a BYM2 model with optional spatially varying coefficients — svy_fit_bym2
text: Fits unit-level (individual cluster) model BYM2 area random effect using INLA. Covariates named svc additionally get area-specific slope, effect can vary across space.

title: Fit a BYM2 model with optional spatially varying coefficients — svy_fit_bym2
code: svy_fit_bym2(   data,   formula,   graph,   area_col = "area_id",   family = "binomial",   Ntrials = NULL,   E = NULL,   svc = NULL,   svc_model = c("besag", "bym2"),   extra_terms = NULL,   priors = svy_priors(),   ... )

title: Fit a BYM2 model with optional spatially varying coefficients — svy_fit_bym2
text: data data frame (sf object) outcome, covariates area identifiers, e.g. survey records joined svy_extract() output. formula Fixed-effects formula, e.g. stunted ~ pm25 + urban. graph svy_graph svy_adjacency(). area_col Area identifier column data (graph$index). family INLA likelihood, e.g. "binomial", "poisson", "gaussian". Ntrials binomial models, name trials column numeric vector. Defaults 1 (Bernoulli). E Poisson models, name offset (expected counts) column numeric vector. svc Character vector numeric covariates give spatially varying slopes. must also appear formula. svc_model Latent model slope deviations: "besag" (ICAR) "bym2". extra_terms Character vector additional formula terms, e.g. "f(cluster_idx, model = 'iid')". priors Output svy_priors(). ... arguments passed INLA::inla().

title: Fit a BYM2 model with optional spatially varying coefficients — svy_fit_bym2
text: object class svy_fit: list INLA fit (inla), graph, data used model settings.

title: Fit a BYM2 model with optional spatially varying coefficients — svy_fit_bym2
text: model record \(\) area \(\) $$g(\mu_i) = \beta_0 + x_i^\top \beta + b_a + \sum_k z_{ik} \gamma_{ka}$$ \(b_a\) BYM2 effect \(\gamma_{ka}\) area deviations slope covariate \(z_k\) (svc). total area-specific slope \(\beta_k + \gamma_{ka}\); see svy_svc_effects().

title: Fit a BYM2 model with optional spatially varying coefficients — svy_fit_bym2
text: INLA fits model-based analysis use sampling weights. Adjust design including stratification variables (e.g. region urban/rural) fixed effects, consider cluster-level iid random effect via extra_terms. design-based small-area prevalence, see SUMMER surveyPrev packages.

title: svyexpo: survey exposure linkage and Bayesian spatial modelling — svyexpo-package
text: package organised six modules. module takes returns ordinary R objects (data frames, sf objects, SpatRasters), step can used swapped code.

title: svyexpo: survey exposure linkage and Bayesian spatial modelling — svyexpo-package
text: Ingest – svy_standardize(), svy_from_dhs(): map survey records onto common schema attach cluster coordinates. Boundaries – svy_boundaries(), svy_assign_areas(): download cache GADM polygons assign clusters administrative areas. Exposure linkage – svy_buffers(), svy_extract(), svy_extract_by_year(): extract raster values within displacement-aware buffers, reading pixels needed. Spatial structure – svy_adjacency(): build neighbourhood graph, repair islands index areas INLA. Models – svy_fit_bym2(): BYM2 models optional spatially varying coefficients. Outputs – svy_area_effects(), svy_svc_effects(), svy_diagnostics(), svy_map(): posterior summaries, exceedance probabilities, model diagnostics maps. svy_simulate() generates small synthetic survey, boundary set exposure raster every step can run without restricted data.

title: svyexpo: survey exposure linkage and Bayesian spatial modelling — svyexpo-package
text: svyexpo.cache_dir: directory used cache GADM downloads. Defaults session temporary directory; set permanent folder avoid repeated downloads, e.g. options(svyexpo.cache_dir = tools::R_user_dir("svyexpo", "cache")).
